about.story: IndiFlavors was born from a passion for authentic Indian cuisine. We believe in using traditional recipes passed down through generations, combined with modern techniques to create a unique dining experience.
about.chef: Chef Raj, with over 20 years of experience in 5-star kitchens, brings his expertise and love for food to every plate.
about.philosophy: Fresh ingredients, authentic spices, and love are the three pillars of our cooking.
